info.title: Eagle Talon: Golden Spell
info.synopsis: L'organizzazione segreta malvagia Eagle Talon riesce a riportare alla luce l'antico "Incantesimo d'Oro" che può controllare le menti umane con una singola parola. "Grazie a ciò possiamo esaudire il nostro sogno di conquistare il mondo da casa!" e inizia a sviluppare vari effetti dell'incantesimo come la magia "fattela addosso". Ma qualcuno ruba il programma di sviluppo! Se il Golden Spell cadesse nelle mani sbagliate il mondo sarebbe in pericolo. Per riottenere gli incantesimi persi, la Eagle Talon inizia le sue indagini. Ma poco a poco vengono trascinati in un complotto ben più grande... Proteggi il mondo mentre mantieni il distanziamento sociale!

It is a new secret weapon that can manipulate humans with just one word and change their appearance. "In this case, even nowadays when the influence of Corona remains, you can conquer the remote world with just voice!" I try to conquer the neighborhood shopping street as a starting point, but ...

episodes.title: Anti-Spell

tvdb.title: Anti-Spell
tvdb.synopsis: The Eagle Talon, whose golden spell generation program has been stolen by someone, infiltrates the IT company "Crotter" in search of clues. There, the president, Kuroki, was suffering from a strange illness that "he would be stupid when he heard a specific word." After discovering that the cause is the golden spell and the mysterious person "Sugar", Dr. Leonardo begins to develop a countermeasure "Anti-Spell", but the material requires rare materials and "words of gratitude" ...

tvdb.title: Baby Talk Spell
tvdb.synopsis: Crotter has another incident! This time, due to the influence of the golden spelling, all employees started to speak baby talk. The Eagle Talon was asked to develop an anti-spell for 2 million yen, but it is extremely difficult for an evil secret society to collect the "words of gratitude" that are the material. So I decided to help the deluxe fighter on the side of justice ... On the other hand, the government found out that a strange in-house broadcast was involved in the case of Crotter, and issued an investigation order to Otori Fuyu of the Cabinet Special Investigation Office, NTS. Give it down.

tvdb.title: Help Spell
tvdb.synopsis: The Eagle Talon who developed a new secret weapon with the anti-spell manufacturing reward paid by Crotter. When I was about to start conquering the world in a nearby park, a deluxe fighter appeared. I thought that I would be blown away suddenly, and said, "Today I will help conquer the world!" The Führer and Yoshida are confused but ask for help, but the Deluxe Fighter gradually goes out of control. In fact, it was contaminated with the "help / spell" released by Sugar!
